available.quote: The board, in its discretion, may waive the examination required by § 63-3-109(c)(3) and may issue a license to any applicant who holds or possesses a valid license to practice podiatry in another state; provided, that the requirements for licensure in such state are, in the opinion of the board, at least equivalent to the requirements for licensure provided by this chapter

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid license in another state with requirements at least equivalent to Tennessee's requirements, and pay the applicable fee. Board has discretion to waive the examination.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud in procuring a license or certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud in procuring a license or certificate;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, drug offense, or offense involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony, conviction of any offense under state or federal drug laws or conviction of any offense involving moral turpitude;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intoxication or personal misuse of any drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual intoxication or personal misuse of any drugs;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral, unethical, unprofessional or dishonorable conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral, unethical, unprofessional or dishonorable conduct;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Solicitation by agents or profiting from acts of persons representing themselves as agents of the licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Solicitation by agents or persons or profiting by the acts of those representing themselves to be agents of the licensee or the certificate holder;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees for referring a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Division of fees or agreeing to split or divide fees received for professional services with any person for bringing or referring a patient;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional connection with any person to avoid or circumvent the chapter or lending one's name to another for the illegal practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional connection or association with any person, firm or corporation in any manner in an effort to avoid and circumvent this chapter or lending one's name to another for the illegal practice of podiatry by such person;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation or attempted violation of the chapter, board orders, or criminal statutes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation or attempted violation, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate this chapter or any lawful order of the board; issued pursuant thereto, or any criminal statute of this state;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving testimonials for secret therapeutic agents or proprietary preparations claiming radical cure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Giving of testimonials, directly or indirectly, concerning the supposed virtue of secret therapeutic agents or proprietary preparations, such as remedies, vaccines or other articles or materials that are offered to the public, claiming radical cure or prevention of disease by their use;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any other unprofessional or unethical conduct as specified by board rules or violation of any chapter provision
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any other unprofessional or unethical conduct that may be specified by the board from time to time by means of rules and regulations duly published and promulgated by the board or the violation of any provision of this chapter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false statements or representations or committing fraud or deceit in the practice of podiatry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making false statements or representations or being guilty of fraud or deceit in the practice of podiatry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing in a field in which the licensee is not licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Invasion of a field of practice in which the licensee is not licensed to practice or is not within the limits of the licensee's respective callings;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing, prescribing, or distributing controlled substances not in the course of professional practice or in violation of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing, prescribing or otherwise distributing any controlled substance or any other drug not in the course of professional practice or not in good faith to relieve pain and suffering, or not to cure an ailment, physical infirmity or disease;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance in violation of state or federal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing, prescribing or otherwise distributing any controlled substance, controlled substance analogue or any other drug to any person in violation of any law of the state or of the United States;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing podiatry under a trade name, location name, or title other than 'podiatrist'
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing podiatry under any trade name or a name designating a given location or the name of another podiatrist or any name other than that which appears on the practitioner's license or using any title other than "podiatrist"

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful violation of board advertising regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful violation of the rules and regulations that may be promulgated by the board of podiatric medical examiners to regulate advertising by practitioners who are under the jurisdiction of the board;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or signing a certificate known to be false
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or signing in one's professional capacity any certificate that is known to be false at the time one makes or signs such certificate;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the practice of podiatry when mentally or physically unable to safely do so
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the practice of podiatry when mentally or physically unable to safely do so;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross health care liability or a pattern of continued or repeated health care liability, ignorance, negligence or incompetence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross health care liability or a pattern of continued or repeated health care liability, ignorance, negligence or incompetence in the course of the practice of podiatry.

definition_quote.value: "podiatrist" means one who examines, diagnoses or treats, medically mechanically or surgically, the ailments of the human foot, ankle and soft tissue structures extending no higher than the distal tibial metaphyseal flair, including the use and prescribing of drugs and medications, but excluding the direct applications of general anesthesia by a podiatrist and the amputation of the foot.
definition_quote.quote: "podiatrist" means one who examines, diagnoses or treats, medically mechanically or surgically, the ailments of the human foot, ankle and soft tissue structures extending no higher than the distal tibial metaphyseal flair, including the use and prescribing of drugs and medications, but excluding the direct applications of general anesthesia by a podiatrist and the amputation of the foot.

methods_authorized.quote: examines, diagnoses or treats, medically mechanically or surgically, the ailments of the human foot, ankle and soft tissue structures

drug_authority.value: Podiatrists are authorized to use and prescribe drugs and medications within their scope of practice.
drug_authority.quote: including the use and prescribing of drugs and medications

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the ailments of the human foot, ankle and soft tissue structures extending no higher than the distal tibial metaphyseal flair

amputation_authorized.quote: excluding the direct applications of general anesthesia by a podiatrist and the amputation of the foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: excluding the direct applications of general anesthesia by a podiatrist

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: A licensed podiatrist may perform ankle surgery only when that podiatrist meets the requirements of either subdivision (b)(1) or (b)(2)

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: Has completed a surgical residency program at least twenty-four (24) months in length that has been approved by the council on podiatric medical education and is currently eligible for certification to perform reconstructive rearfoot/ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: A licensed podiatrist may perform ankle surgery only in an accredited hospital or ambulatory surgical treatment center licensed under title 68 at which the podiatrist has surgical privileges to perform ankle surgery.

board_certification_body.quote: currently eligible for certification to perform reconstructive rearfoot/ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery

xray_technician_certification_required.quote: no person shall perform X-ray procedures in a podiatrist office who does not meet these standards and who has not received a certificate of proficiency from the board.

ankle_surgery_board_certification_timeli.value: within six (6) years of May 24, 2000, or within six (6) years of first becoming eligible for certification, whichever date is later
ankle_surgery_board_certification_timeli.quote: must obtain certification to perform reconstructive rearfoot/ankle surgery from the American Board of Podiatric Surgery within six (6) years of May 24, 2000, or within six (6) years of first becoming eligible for certification, whichever date is later

tibial_pilon_fracture_excluded.quote: A podiatrist may perform Achilles tendon repair, subject to subsection (b), but may not perform surgery on Pilon fractures or tibial fractures that do not enter the ankle joint.

physician_assistant_collaboration_author.quote: A licensed podiatrist may collaborate with a physician assistant or an orthopedic physician assistant licensed pursuant to chapter 19 of this title.

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: No part or portion of this chapter shall be deemed to prohibit the usual and customary commercial sale and adjustment of foot appliances and remedies or shoes in retail stores.

ankle_surgery_standard_of_care_reference.quote: A licensed podiatrist who performs ankle surgery must meet the same standard of care applicable to orthopedic surgeons who perform ankle surgery.

impaired_practitioner_program.quote: Regulatory boards, commissions and agencies attached to the division of health related boards, in addition to other enumerated powers and duties, have as their purpose assistance in the rehabilitation of impaired health practitioners who are licensed, certified or registered by the respective regulatory boards, commissions and agencies.
